title: CALL FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST FROM REPUTED SCHOLARS, EXPERTS, INSTITUTIONS, NGOs ETC.
summary: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd (IPRCL) notification calling expressions of interest and brief proposals from scholars, experts, artistes, institutions and NGOs to collaborate with the National Maritime Heritage Complex (NMHC) Society at Lothal, Gujarat, on education, research, cultural and tourism programmes.

procurement.issuing_office: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd. (JV under Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways), for National Maritime Heritage Complex, Lothal

sites.name: National Maritime Heritage Complex, Lothal, Sagarwala, Gujarat - 382230
sites.work: Collaboration on education, research, skilling, cultural experiences, publications, exhibitions, festivals, tourism promotion and maritime heritage circuits

scope.item: Exposure, sensitisation and awareness generation amongst youth and children
Artistic productions: films, theatre, operas, dance dramas and the like
Curating maritime heritage tourist circuits, especially coastal and river cruises in India and ocean cruises in the extended Indosphere

eligibility: Renowned scholars, experts, artistes, institutions, NGOs etc. involved in the listed areas
Submission to include: proposal with details; details of organisation and expertise including earlier similar work (CV for individuals); support required from NMHC
notes: Not a DGLL tender: issued by IPRCL (Sagarmala) for the NMHC Society, Lothal; hosted on the DGLL tenders listing. Proposals by e-mail to the GM (Marketing) NMHC mailbox gm.mktg.nmhc@gmail.com or by post to GM (Marketing), NMHC Lothal; a clarification mobile number is printed ([personal contact removed]). No monetary values.
